paragraphs: The X6 xDrive50e is a plug-in hybrid variant within the G06 generation of the BMW X6, which launched in 2019. It uses BMW's well-regarded B58 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine — the same core engine found across many current BMW models — paired with an integrated electric motor and a battery pack. The hybrid system adds electric-only driving capability alongside the petrol engine's output, making the xDrive50e one of the most powerful plug-in hybrid options in the X6 range.
about.boldParagraph: The X6 xDrive50e is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
